evidence.observation: P 3.002 Torr at growth start, matching the ~2.95-3.01 Torr seen through the ramp at 100 sccm
P has climbed every reading to 3.339 Torr, about +0.08 Torr per 120 s, far beyond the ~0.03 Torr noise seen earlier
Ar steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by more gas flowing in
T holding at 750 °C with Pheat ~45%, normal
not installed, so an air leak (seal_leak) cannot be told apart from a restricted exhaust (exhaust_blockage)

args.missing_evidence: Something that separates leak from blockage: briefly stop or step the Ar flow and watch the pressure (a rate-of-rise leak check), check the pump/exhaust line for restriction, or add an O2 or residual-gas reading. No reference [mean, sd] band was provided to compare against.
